block_a_marginal_estimator_coverage_gap.statement: Block A's forward-pass marginal estimator needs K=8 real sampled <think> traces per (model, target) as tau_k. These four (model, ASTRAL) combinations still have NO raw trace file after Block A's regeneration -- only the pre-existing structured-only fallback (precursors/max_T/reward/match, no reasoning text) -- because astral_model_generations.py (the script Block A's ASTRAL legs used) never persists completion text.
block_a_marginal_estimator_coverage_gap.consequence: the marginal estimator cannot be computed for these 4 models x 35 ASTRAL targets = 140 (model,target) cells; only the answer-only (empty-think) estimator can be. Gate G1's own rule (median Spearman >=0.5 under the MARGINAL estimator, every model) has no marginal-estimator number to check for these 4 models on ASTRAL at all -- this is a coverage gap, not a predicted gate failure, and needs a decision (skip ASTRAL for these 4 under G1 and gate on held-out only, or spend a 7th GPU leg re-generating ASTRAL samples with completion text saved) before Block A's real forward-pass job is scoped.
